arguments.command:
cat > /tmp/sess.sh <<'EOF'
for r in $(git for-each-ref refs/inspect --format='%(refname)'); do
  git log --reverse --format='%H %ct' $r | while read h t; do
    git show $h:batch.json | jq -c --arg t "$t" '.writes[]|select(.type=="entry")|{t:($t|tonumber),k:.value.kind,tools:([.value.model[]?|select(.role=="assistant")|.content[]?|select(.type=="toolCall")|.name]|join(","))}'
  done > /tmp/$(basename $r).jsonl
done
EOF
bash /tmp/sess.sh; wc -l /tmp/[0-9]*.jsonl | tail -1; head -20 /tmp/46.jsonl
